headline: Brazil’s MGI considers stronger rules for federal workers’ use of AI tools
summary: A Sep 14, 2026 Tele.Síntese interview reported that Brazil’s Management and Innovation Minister Esther Dweck was considering giving an existing ethical-AI-use manual for federal workers stronger force as a Portaria or presidential decree. Dweck also said a federal self-assessment found more than 150 AI solutions already in use and more than 300 initiatives under study or development. The statements document reported policy intent and ministry-reported inventory counts, not an enacted nationwide rule or audited outcomes. A bounded official MGI search found ministry-level governance and guidance but no manual-specific nationwide instrument; a full Diário Oficial check remains open.
